review_scope: Golden yellow torso with pale gold and muted green fine flowing mineral/woodgrain-like lines, plain yellow sleeves and thin grey-green raglan/neck piping. Constant-color contours of a clear lower-front mineral print crop repeated with reflection; no source fabric pixels embedded. Independent current variant source visually inspected. limitations: Colors and placement are visual adaptations; original PNG round collar, fabric and folds retained.
